To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the elite is larger than the average degree of the network, but smaller than the maximum degree of the network.

(i) the elite is an emergent property of the society, (ii) the elite is a relatively small, highly-connected group of individuals that is well-positioned to exert a disproportionate amount of influence, and (iii) the size of the elites is the result of conflicting social processes that compete to increase or decrease its size.

the elite of any social network can be defined as the smallest group of individuals such that every individual in the group is reachable by any individual in the network, and the size of the group is a result of competing social forces.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the size of the social elite.
the following questions: What is an elite?
the following question: what are the forces that shape the size of the elites of social networks?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the size of the social elite is a function of the social network, the social structure, and the social norms of the society.
the elite size is determined by a balance between the forces of social integration and differentiation.
there is no single factor that can be considered to be the cause of the rise and fall of elites.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to understand the size of the social elite and the factors that determine its size.
we propose a new approach to the analysis of elites in social networks.
we have proposed a model for the size of an elite in a social network, and we have shown how this model can be applied to the case of Twitter.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the size of the social elite is a result not just of a single force but rather of a complex interplay between the forces of social influence, which increase the size of the network elite, and those of social homophily, which decrease it.
the elite is a social phenomenon that is not a mere consequence of the network structure, but rather a result of the interplay of the structure and the dynamics of the network.
the size of the elites is not fixed but rather a dynamic result of the social forces that are at play in the society.
